# Pravesh Singh

> Official machine-readable context and site index for praveshsingh.com.
> Last updated: 2026-09-21 · Language: en-IN

## Identity & Executive Positioning

Pravesh Singh is an Indian software engineer, entrepreneur, and the Managing Director and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of SoftEdge Technology Solutions. With 15+ years of software architecture and hands-on engineering experience, he designs mission-critical clinical healthcare platforms, multi-tenant SaaS products, deterministic automation pipelines, and enterprise systems across public and private sectors.

## Key Roles & Affiliations

- **Managing Director & CTO**, SoftEdge Technology Solutions (https://softedgetechnology.com)
- **Software Architect & Creator**, iCare (Digital Clinical Registry & Biological Cold-Chain Inventory Platform)
- **Software Architect & Creator**, TaskEdge (Multi-Tenant Operations Task Management SaaS)
- **Direct Technical Advisor & Fractional CTO** on healthcare integrations, database architecture, and compliance.

## Capability Pillars

1. **Mission-Critical Healthcare Platforms:** Specialized in Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM M1/M2/M3) integrations, HL7 FHIR R4 interoperability, offline-tolerant clinical hospital systems, and cold-chain medicine inventory ledgers.
2. **Multi-Tenant SaaS Engineering:** PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) isolation, high-concurrency API performance, tenant-aware database sharding, audit-ready compliance trails, and enterprise role-based access control (RBAC).
3. **Deterministic Applied AI & Data Extraction:** Moving beyond prompt engineering through schema-constrained LLM generation (JSON Schema / Pydantic), mathematical invariant validation, citation anchoring, and automated ETL pipelines.
4. **Fractional CTO & Architecture Advisory:** Technology due diligence, code & security audits, modernization roadmaps, database query optimization, and DPDP Act 2023 compliance consulting.

## Primary Software Systems

### iCare (Clinical Registry & Inventory Logistics)
- **Overview:** State-deployed clinical patient registry and cold-chain biological medicine inventory platform for hemophilia and thalassemia care.
- **Impact:** Live across state hospital networks in Punjab and Madhya Pradesh.
- **Key Features:** Cross-hospital portable patient profiles, double-entry biological inventory ledgers (Factor VIII/IX), nearest-expiry (FEFO) allocation, ABDM FHIR R4 compatibility, and real-time state health commissioner analytics.
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/icare.html

### TaskEdge (Operations Management SaaS)
- **Overview:** Fast, low-overhead multi-tenant operations execution system designed for deskless and shift-based teams.
- **Key Features:** True tenant isolation, sub-50ms task updates, structured shift handovers, zero-training UX, and automated audit logging.
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/taskedge.html

### Practical AI & Automation Engines
- **Overview:** Deterministic extraction and document automation pipelines for clinical discharge summaries, government reporting formats, and high-volume financial invoices.
- **URL:** https://praveshsingh.com/automation.html

## Commercial Engagement Packages & Advisory

All advisory work is delivered directly by Pravesh Singh. Turnkey platform builds and SLA-backed engineering teams are executed through SoftEdge Technology Solutions.

1. **System Architecture & Codebase Audit:** 2-week fixed-scope engagement evaluating scalability bottlenecks, PostgreSQL performance, security posture, and multi-tenancy boundaries. Deliverables include prioritized findings and executive roadmap.
2. **Fractional CTO & Technical Advisory:** Retainer-based partnership (10–20 hrs/month) providing architectural steering, hiring evaluation, technology selection, and board/investor representation.
3. **ABDM & Healthcare Integration Sprint:** Fixed-scope integration sprint delivering production-ready M1/M2/M3 milestone compliance, FHIR R4 document mapping, ABHA authentication, and sandbox certification.
4. **Custom SaaS & Platform Engineering:** Full lifecycle platform builds executed by dedicated SoftEdge engineering squads under direct CTO oversight with milestone delivery and IP assignment.

Full commercial transparency & inquiry generator: https://praveshsingh.com/expertise.html

## Technical Writing & Architectural Essays

Pravesh Singh authors in-depth, production-grounded engineering guides on systems architecture:
- **Writing Hub:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/index.html
- **Offline-Tolerant Hospital Software:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/offline-tolerant-hospital-software.html (Engineering clinical software for intermittent power and high-latency hospital counters).
- **ABDM Integration Developer Guide:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/abdm-integration-developer-guide.html (A pragmatic engineering walkthrough of ABHA, HIP/HIU, FHIR R4 JSON, and ECDH encryption).
- **Multi-Tenant PostgreSQL Isolation:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/multi-tenant-postgresql-isolation.html (Schema-per-Tenant vs Shared-Schema RLS, connection pooling with PgBouncer, and performance benchmarks).
- **Double-Entry Medicine Inventory Ledgers:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/high-value-medicine-inventory-logistics.html (Applying immutable financial ledger accounting to biological pharmaceuticals).
- **Structured Data Extraction with LLMs:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/structured-data-extraction-llm-limits.html (Schema-constrained decoding, Pydantic validation loops, and invoice parsing).
- **DPDP Act 2023 HealthTech Architecture:** https://praveshsingh.com/writing/dpdp-act-2023-health-tech-checklist.html (10-point engineering checklist for consent management, erasure, and audit logging).
